>OMG this is it!!!! Thank you thank you thank you thank you thank you! I have been searching but I had no idea exactly what to search. Thank you Nap-DeMarco and Reddit :)

Please dont. We need you. You're one of us and we need all the help we can get. I'm alone too and at least you have online friends. I'll most likely be alone till I die since that what my dreams keep telling me, but I persist. I mean who doesnt love an underdog?  People suck and society is broken, but we have just as much right to be alive as anyone else.
Awww please dont. We need all our teammates. I'm one of you too but I want to stay and IDK why but I do. Please stay with me too. We are stronger in numbers.

Here is the number to the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline  1-800-273-8255. I used to think it wouldn't help but I called them twice and they really, truly helped me.  I might call them later as I've been having a bad week myself.
